content: Creation of the Ecu Extract The ECU Extract is ex- tracted from the System Configuration for each ECU. As explained in the [9, AUTOSAR TPS System Template], this contains an ECU-centric view onto the system description. This includes a reduced version of the system’s RootSwCompositionProto- type where SwComponentPrototype s not being mapped to the ECU are being left out and all Compositions are stripped off, so that in the ECU Extract only 662 of 1277 Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_CP_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R25-11 one instance of CompositionSwComponentType remains which aggregates all SwComponentPrototype s on the ECU in a flat manner.
